headline: Book of Moon
title: Book of Moon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Book of Moon. What is it? It is a Quick-Play Spell Card. What does it do? Target one face-up monster on the field and change it to face-down Defense Position. How do you use it? Use it on your opponent's turn to stop a monster's effects on the field or to stop its attack, because a face-down monster cannot attack. You can also flip your own Flip monsters face-down to use them again. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
